why: Searches turned up only unrefereed crank preprints claiming proof or disproof of RH/GRH (circulating for years, not credible), and one 2025 arXiv paper (Suzuki, 2508.17701) that is conditional on RH and studies an equivalence with GRH for Dirichlet L-functions rather than proving/disproving or narrowing it. No credible source moves the actual statement.
